label: Add Link
description: Links the resource this step acts on, the one an earlier step created or else the target, to the content the event names. An event naming nothing links nothing, so a workflow can link as an option.

to.label: To
to.description: The event entry holding the path of the content linked to, e.g. "source".

linkType.label: Link type
linkType.description: The type of the link, e.g. "copiedFrom".

linkLabel.label: Link label
linkLabel.description: A label for the link. Left blank, the link has none.
